{{Top|leg}}
'''Toz''' was a [[Grain/Legends|grain]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] and was transplanted to many other planets of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. It was used to make [[Utoz/Legends|utoz]] as well as breads, mushes, and flours.
